__broaden__.jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's
